messages:
alex: Heads up — deploy-bot reported a canary regression for payments-service in eu-west. Chart bumped to 1.4.2 changed sidecar env ordering and canary pods entered CrashLoopBackOff. deploy-bot shows canary health at 30% (3/10). Do we pin back to 1.4.1 or hotpatch the values?

deploy-bot: deploy 1723456780: canary rollout payments-service eu-west started. canary_fraction=10, healthy=3/10, reason=CrashLoopBackOff in sidecar init. rollback_available=true
maria: quick log from pod payments-svc-canary-2: ```2024-05-10T14:12:03Z ERROR startup: missing required env: CONFIG_PATH
panic: exit status 1``` Looks like init sidecar expects CONFIG_PATH before LOG_LEVEL — the chart template changed the env list order in 1.4.2.
devon: confirmed. Chart 1.4.2 values.yml reorders sidecar.env, PR #382 introduced the reorder to consolidate but it caused init race. Options: 1) rollback/pin to 1.4.1 in eu-west, 2) hotpatch canary values to explicitly set env order and restart, 3) kill canary and pause promotions.
sophia: Oncall prefers rollback if it avoids user impact. Crashloop on canary suggests roll back to be safe. @ryan can you take lead? :eyes:
ryan: I'll take it. Plan: pin chart to 1.4.1 only in eu-west and stop auto-promote for this release until we patch. Command I will run: ```helm upgrade payments-service redwood/payments --version 1.4.1 --namespace eu-west --reuse-values --set deploybot.prevent_promote=true``` Also will annotate the deployment to prevent automated canary promotion.
alex: Good. Add a release-note stub: "hotfix: pin payments-service chart to 1.4.1 in eu-west due to sidecar init env-order regression; full rollout paused." We'll also create follow-up to revert the reorder in chart and add a unit test for env ordering.
maria: Quick sanity check on image digests: images are unchanged (payments-sidecar:sha256:abc123). So it's definitely chart values change.
deploy-bot: action queued by ryan at 1723457200: pin chart version 1.4.1 for payments-service in eu-west. status=pending
ryan: ran helm command at 1723457200 and patched annotations. deploy-bot: action taken at 1723457200. Post-action health: canary halted, pods stabilized to stable deployment of 1.4.1.
sophia: Please schedule a change window for reattempt after chart fix. Propose 2024-05-12 22:00 UTC for a controlled rollout with an engineer oncall and QA smoke.
devon: +1. Before resuming, let's run these checks in staging: `helm template` against chart 1.4.2 with values and `kubectl apply --dry-run=server` plus our circleci preflight script. Also add a helm preinstall test that asserts sidecar.env ordering via `tpl` rendered output.
alex: I'll open the release notes PR with the pinned rollback note and assign tickets: CHART-423 (revert reorder + test), QA-211 (staging smoke), OPS-88 (schedule window). Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
